title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
@cursor Fix Part 4 of issue #3 (round 2): Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking.

Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts and Commits), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and the whole issue #3 first. Do ONLY this fix. Push to the existing branch `day-03/dom-snapshot`. Do not open a new PR. Do not start Part 5.

What I checked and what is fine: CI is green on `e4ea2a6`. The `test: fix` commit comes before the fix commit and only changes the masked select test plus one new test. `selected` is gone from every option of a masked select, also when the HTML had a `selected` attribute. The `maskAllInputs: false` test still expects `selected: true`. ADR 0017 exists, ADR 0015 status and `docs/decisions/README.md` are updated, and so is `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`. Commit messages match.

What is still wrong:

1. `packages/recorder/src/snapshot/serialize-node.ts`, `applySelect`: the choice still leaks through the star length. A masked select records its value as stars of the same length (`****`), and each option value is also stars of its own length (`*****` for apple, `****` for pear). A reader only has to find the option whose stars have the same length as the select value. In the fixture of `records the selected option and masks the select value by default`, exactly one option has 4 stars, so the recording still says "Pear". This is the same leak as round 1: the chosen option is recoverable.
